*Salesforce and pioneering voice agent developers join Bandwidth to showcase breakthroughs* *in SI-powered customer experiences and trusted communications*


RALEIGH, N.C.


, Nov. 3, 2026


/PRNewswire/ –[Bandwidth Inc.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4812388-1&h=2401163239&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bandwidth.com%2F&a=Bandwidth+Inc.) (NASDAQ: BAND), a leading global cloud communications company, will unveil the newest innovations to help enterprises deploy Super Intelligence-powered communications at Reverb® on Nov. 10. The annual product keynote and customer showcase will feature advances in intelligent customer experiences and trusted communications, alongside live demonstrations and firsthand insights from customers putting SI to work with Bandwidth.


**The Reverb agenda includes:**


- Real-world SI deployments by Bandwidth customers, including global technology leader Salesforce and pioneering voice agent developers Bland.ai, Flip and GeniusAI;
- Advances in the Bandwidth Maestro™ platform’s SI voice orchestration capabilities;
- Innovations in global voice infrastructure, including advanced observability tools, an expanded global footprint and new edge capabilities to drive even greater SI communications performance;
- An expansion of Bandwidth’s Trust portfolio to protect enterprise calling reputation and help customers recognize and trust legitimate calls;
- And much more, for both business and technical leaders.


[Register for Reverb](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4812388-1&h=3274364856&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bandwidth.com%2Fevent%2Freverb%2F%3Futm_source%3Dpressrelease%26utm_medium%3Dpr%26utm_campaign%3DREV26&a=Register+for+Reverb) to attend in person or via the livestream Nov. 10 at 10:30 am EST, and be among the first to hear the announcements and join the conversation shaping the future of SI-powered enterprise communications. A replay will be available for all registrants.


[Bandwidth Inc.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4812388-1&h=2401163239&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bandwidth.com%2F&a=Bandwidth+Inc.) (NASDAQ: BAND) is a leading global cloud communications company that helps enterprises deliver exceptional experiences through voice calling, text messaging and emergency services. Our solutions and our Communications Cloud, covering ~70 countries and 90 percent of global GDP, are trusted by all the leaders in unified communications and cloud contact centers–including Amazon Web Services (AWS), Cisco, Google, Microsoft, RingCentral, Zoom, Genesys and Five9–as well as Global 2000 enterprises and SaaS builders like Docusign, Uber and Yosi Health. As a founder of the cloud communications revolution, we are the first and only global Communications Platform-as-a-Service (CPaaS) to offer a unique combination of composable APIs, Super Intelligence capabilities, owner-operated network and broad regulatory experience. Our award-winning support teams help businesses around the world transform their communications every day.
